name: Filter Wasos entries
info: Filters WaSOS chat messages to only include new entries. Removes messages older than the last sync timestamp and excludes messages with [rayvn] callsign to prevent duplicates.

name: Filter by time
info: Filters messages by timestamp. Only keeps messages newer than lastWasosEntryTimeStamp to avoid reprocessing old data.

name: Filter by callsign
info: Filters out messages with [rayvn] in the callsign. These messages originated from Rayvn and should not be sent back to prevent infinite loops.

name: stop empty injects
info: stops and output from this subflow if empty or null
